### Helpful Hope for Broken Dreams
Author: Charles Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-january-18-2024.html
Passage: 1 Chronicles 22:5-6
Points:
- When God says no to fulfilling a personal vision, it reveals He has a better way.
- Rather than holding on to bitterness, believers should respond with humility and willing cooperation.
- Mature believers should unselfishly prepare resources to support younger leaders stepping into leadership.
- God can abundantly fill empty hands when surrendered to Him in obedience and praise.

### Devotional: 1 Chronicles 22
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/1-chronicles-22-1-peter-3-micah-1-luke-10/
Passage: 1 Chronicles 22:1
Points:
- David establishes the temple site where sacrifice was made and God's wrath was averted.
- Genuine biblical worship focuses on being reconciled to God rather than outward ceremonial rituals.
- Sinful people cannot presume to approach a holy God without the atonement He provides.
- A king determining the site of the sanctuary foreshadows Christ uniting the kingly and priestly offices.
